task_name: Build admin operational readiness web surface

concerns_addressed: Page tests validate readiness blocked/ready states, issue listing, and disabled activation-required rendering without source mutation or client-side truth computation.
Sidebar gating keeps admin operation navigation behind the existing auth/role convention.

strengths: Reusable API client (apiUrl/authHeaders/getStoredToken) and existing UI primitives are used; types live alongside the client.
Loading/error/blocked/ready states and disabled handle are explicit rather than inferred.
Filters/detail are server-owned; client only serializes allowlisted values and presents safe detail.
Typecheck green; 8 web tests passing for operations page.
